Training¶

.. py:module:: xtrax.training

Training module for supervised learning with JAX.

.. py:class:: Trainer(loss_fn, optimizer) :module: xtrax.training :canonical: xtrax.training.trainer.Trainer

Bases: :py:class:~equinox._module._module.Module

Single-model trainer for supervised learning.

.. attribute:: loss_fn

  Callable[[predictions, targets], scalar loss].

.. attribute:: optimizer

  optax.GradientTransformation for parameter updates.

Invariants: - step() is eqx.filter_jit-decorated. - Gradients computed via eqx.filter_value_and_grad. - Optimizer.update() receives eqx.filter(state.model, eqx.is_array) as third argument (required for weight-decay compatibility). - Returns new ResumableState with incremented step and updated model/opt_state. - Metrics dict always includes at minimum {“loss”: scalar}.

.. py:attribute:: Trainer.optimizer :module: xtrax.training :type: ~optax._src.base.GradientTransformation

.. py:class:: SafetyTrainStep(trainer, safety_manager) :module: xtrax.training :canonical: xtrax.training.step.SafetyTrainStep

Bases: :py:class:~equinox._module._module.Module

Safe training step wrapper with NaN/Inf detection via checkify.

PUBLIC FIELDS (spec §3.14 requirement): trainer: Trainer instance for base training logic. safety_manager: SafetyManager for configuring checks.

Architecture: - _step_jit: filter_jit’d method returning (err, (new_state, metrics)) - step: Plain Python wrapper calling _step_jit then err.throw() on host

This design ensures err.throw() (which raises Python exceptions) runs outside the JIT boundary, allowing proper exception handling on the host.

.. py:attribute:: SafetyTrainStep.trainer :module: xtrax.training :type: ~xtrax.training.trainer.Trainer

.. py:attribute:: SafetyTrainStep.safety_manager :module: xtrax.training :type: ~xtrax.safety.manager.SafetyManager

.. py:class:: Callback(*args, **kwargs) :module: xtrax.training :canonical: xtrax.training.types.Callback

Bases: :py:class:~typing.Protocol

Protocol for training callbacks with 7 hooks.

All hooks run Python-side (outside JAX traces). Mutating state in a callback has no effect on training since state is immutable.

.. py:class:: WeightedLoss(loss_fn, weight) :module: xtrax.training :canonical: xtrax.training.loss.WeightedLoss

Bases: :py:class:~equinox._module._module.Module

Combines a loss function with a static weight multiplier.

The weight field is marked as static to ensure it does not appear in JAX array filtering — it is a Python float, not a JAX Array. This allows the loss function to be traced and JIT-compiled while the weight remains a compile-time constant.

.. attribute:: loss_fn

  A callable implementing the LossFunction protocol.

.. attribute:: weight

  A Python float (compile-time constant) multiplying the loss.

.. py:attribute:: WeightedLoss.loss_fn :module: xtrax.training :type: ~xtrax.training.types.LossFunction

.. py:attribute:: WeightedLoss.weight :module: xtrax.training :type: float

.. py:method:: WeightedLoss.call(predictions, targets) :module: xtrax.training

  Apply the loss function and scale by weight.

  :type predictions: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:data\:\`\~typing.Any\``
  :param predictions: Model predictions (PyTree).
  :type targets: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:data\:\`\~typing.Any\``
  :param targets: Target values (PyTree).

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~jax.Array\``
  :returns: Scalar Array equal to weight * loss_fn(predictions, targets).

.. py:class:: MultiTaskLoss(losses, weight_schedule=None) :module: xtrax.training :canonical: xtrax.training.loss.MultiTaskLoss

Bases: :py:class:~equinox._module._module.Module

Combines multiple weighted losses for multi-task learning.

Each task has its own WeightedLoss. The call method sums the contributions from all tasks. Length validation ensures predictions, targets, and losses are all the same length.

Optionally applies a dynamic weight schedule that scales the total loss based on the training step.

.. attribute:: losses

  Tuple of WeightedLoss instances, one per task.

.. attribute:: weight_schedule

  Optional callable that takes step and returns a scalar
  multiplier for the total loss. If None, no schedule is applied.
  Must be eqx.field(static=True) as it holds a Python callable.

.. py:attribute:: MultiTaskLoss.losses :module: xtrax.training :type: tuple[~xtrax.training.loss.WeightedLoss, …]

.. py:attribute:: MultiTaskLoss.weight_schedule :module: xtrax.training :type: ~collections.abc.Callable[[int], ~jax.Array] | None :value: None

  Compute sum of all task losses with optional dynamic weight schedule.

  :type step: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`int\``
